Name: Toddler with Twintail Hairstyle - Taking After Parents (Content Patcher)
Author: Kamikou
Description:
[center]This mod is for the female toddler only. I hope you all enjoy it!

[b]Update 3.0[/b]
I have added toddlers that take after the parents. This includes the NPC bachelor (Victor) and bachelorette (Sophia) from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿.

[b]Requirements:[/b]
-Content Patcher
-SMAPI

[b]Instructions:
[/b]Extract the file into your mods folder.
Steam > steamapps > common > Stardew Valley > Mods

The toddler is set as a default color. To change, go into the content folder and change "FromFile": "assets/Default.png" to "FromFile": "assets/XXX.png"

XXX = the name of your spouse

These are the spouses available:
Abigail
Alex
Elliot
Emily
Haley
Harvey
Leah
Maru
Penny
Sam
Sebastian
Shane
Sophia (SVE)
Victor (SVE)

Please do not reupload this mod (or modifications and/or recolors of this mod) anywhere else. Thank you all for taking an interest in my mod![/center]
Update History:
[size=1][b]Update 2.0[/b]
I added a toddler with blonde hair and green eyes. Brunette hair with blue eyes is set as the default. If you want blonde hair with green eyes, go into the content folder and change "FromFile": "assets/Twintails_Toddler.png" to "FromFile": "assets/Twintails_Toddler_Blonde.png"[/size]
